annotations.title: Get the AIO Framework V/E/S vocabulary

description: The machine-readable AIO Framework vocabulary: 19 value codes, 10 evidence codes, 10 source codes, the context axes (domain, scope, reversibility, time horizon), the AIO 20002 record grammar, and a JSON Schema for one record line. Use this to emit or validate AIO 20002 records. CC BY 4.0.

layer.description: Return one layer only. V/L4 = value, E/L3 = evidence, S/L2 = source.
